name: Wild Hearts
summary: Rane Yorick seeks help in Silverpine Forest as her brother Quinn lies badly wounded. She needs discolored worg hearts for Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher, whose alchemy may help Quinn recover.

sections.title: A Brother's Desperation
sections.body: Rane Yorick stays beside her severely wounded brother, Quinn, after the Deathstalkers' disastrous mission left them pinned down at a farm in northern Silverpine. The feral ghoul Ivar the Foul mauled Quinn, and he is failing to recover. Ordinary rest cannot mend an undead body torn by such savagery. Rane turns to the Royal Apothecary Society and its grim arts for a way to put her brother back together.

sections.title: Alchemy of the Scourge-Tainted Wilds
sections.body: The worgs of Silverpine carry the corruption spreading through northern Lordaeron. Their hearts are discolored and hold potent essences. The Royal Apothecaries can distill these blighted organs into concoctions that restore withered Forsaken flesh.

sections.title: Renferrel's Cold Duty
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel works at the Sepulcher and greets the request with frustration, not sympathy. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has charged him with pressing research, and he resents the Royal Apothecary Society being treated as field medics for blundering scouts. Still, he takes the gruesome ingredients and prepares a draught to keep the Dark Lady's agents operational.

faq.q: Why does Quinn Yorick need worg hearts to heal?
faq.answer: Forsaken bodies need special alchemical aid to heal. Quinn was grievously wounded by Ivar the Foul, and the Royal Apothecary Society uses tainted, discolored Silverpine worg hearts to brew tonics for undead tissue.

faq.q: Where can the discolored worg hearts be found?
faq.answer: Discolored worg hearts can be found among the worgs roaming central Silverpine Forest, especially between the road where the Yorick siblings are stranded and Malden's Orchard to the east.
Ivar the Foul is a dangerous ghoul at the farm where the Yoricks took shelter. He attacked Rane and Quinn as they scouted there; both escaped, but Quinn was badly mauled.

faq.q: Why is Apothecary Renferrel annoyed by the task?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel works at the Sepulcher and says the Dark Lady charged him with grave work. He sees failed Deathstalker scouting as an embarrassment and a distraction from his greater alchemical experiments.

faq.q: What happens after giving the hearts to Renferrel?
aliases: what to do with the potion
faq.answer: After processing the discolored hearts, Renferrel sends you back to Rane and Quinn Yorick with a restorative potion. It can help Quinn recover enough to seek vengeance.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers need help from an adventurer?
aliases: why can't rane get the hearts
faq.answer: Rane Yorick cannot leave Quinn's side while he is so badly injured, and roaming Scourge and beasts threaten another ambush. She depends on passing Horde travelers to gather the organs and carry her plea to the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know the Forsaken survive through ruthless pragmatism. Even brotherhood may depend on scavenged organs and cold alchemy rather than divine grace.
As a Rogue, you see seasoned Deathstalkers laid low by a feral ghoul. Their fate warns how much stealth and skill it takes to survive the Lordaeron wilderness.
